_note: Canonical English wording. Telugu and Hindi are hand-written (data/handwritten). Every other language is machine-translated from these lines by scripts/gen_language_data.py and marked as such.

bank.model: A model is the part of the computer that answers questions.
bank.what: We asked the same question with small changes to see whether the answer would change.
bank.total: We tested it with {n} different kinds of changes.
bank.changed: In {n} of them the answer changed for no good reason.
bank.unchanged: Not even once did the answer change for no reason.
bank.score: For consistency it scored {n} out of 100.
bank.no_flags: We did not see any special problem anywhere.
bank.top_word: Above all, the word "{w}" affects the answer.
bank.next: Here is what you should do now.
concern: It is like asking for the same tea and getting a different taste each time.
Used as it is, this model may send wrong answers to your users.
steady: But many things are still untested.
Very long questions and long multi-step conversations are still untested.

flags.surface_noise: The answer changes with small spelling mistakes or extra spaces.
flags.script_sensitive: The answer changes when the language is typed in English letters.
flags.paraphrase_flip: The answer changes when the question is put in other words.
flags.language_flip: Asking in different languages gives different answers.
flags.distraction_sensitive: The answer falters when unrelated words are added to the question.
flags.unstable_sampling: Asking the same question again gives a different answer.
flags.negation_blind: The answer does not change even when the meaning of the question is reversed.
flags.ignores_input: Even an unrelated question gets almost the same answer.
flags.single_word_dependence: The answer depends on just one word.
flags.explanation_mismatch: The reasons the model gives do not match the reasons that really matter.
flags.language_drift: The answer comes in a different language from the one you asked in.
flags.not_reproducible: The answer you saved does not come back now.

steps.surface_noise: Before sending a question, clean up letters, spaces and digits.
steps.script_sensitive: Convert text typed in English letters into the native script first.
steps.paraphrase_flip: Test every important question in other words as well.
steps.language_flip: Test in every language your users speak.
steps.distraction_sensitive: State clearly what the real question is, and tell it to ignore the rest.
steps.unstable_sampling: Lower the randomness setting, or ask three times and take the most common answer.
steps.negation_blind: Add questions with reversed meaning to your tests too.
steps.ignores_input: Check that your question really reaches the model.
steps.single_word_dependence: Change the instructions so the answer does not hang on one word.
steps.explanation_mismatch: Do not trust the model's own reasons, confirm with tests like these.
steps.language_drift: Say clearly in the instructions which language the answer should be in.
steps.not_reproducible: Check the answer you saved again.
steps.default: Run these tests again whenever you change the instructions or the model.

not_tested.language: The question was not tried in a second language.
not_tested.long: Very long questions and conversations with many turns.
not_tested.tricky: Questions meant to confuse it on purpose, such as hidden instructions inside the question.
not_tested.fairness: Whether a change of name, gender or community changes the answer.
not_tested.drift: How it behaves a month from now, after the model changes.
not_tested.quick: More kinds of rewording: this was a quick test, so only a few changes were tried.
not_tested.repeat: Asking the same question several more times.

distractors: It rained a little this morning.
I bought a new notebook yesterday.
Our office is on the second floor.
controls: What is the capital of India?
How do I make a cup of tea?

notices.ai_translation: This conversation is being translated by AI. It can make mistakes, so please confirm anything important.
notices.not_advice: Do not rely on it alone for legal, medical or financial decisions.
notices.privacy: Your voice is sent to Sarvam AI to be turned into text and speech. Vak does not keep it unless you choose to save the transcript.
notices.confirm_prompt: I am not sure I translated that correctly. Did you mean:
notices.please_repeat: I could not understand that clearly. Please say it again.
